about: Plan node Q6, fix round (review defect: for a sequence the covers line did not say that 'accepted' and 'rejected' are the LAST call's answer). Expectations FROZEN in a commit before the code of the `sequence` line existed and before any run of it. expected.json is not edited. Kinds: 0 accepted, 1 rejected, 2 no answer.
what_the_line_is: For a claim whose operation is a sequence of two or more calls, the display has a `sequence` line, placed directly after the covers line. It says that 'accepted', 'rejected' and the answer are those of the LAST call, names that call and the earlier ones by the operations' own nouns, and says that the sequence gives no answer when any call of it gives none. It is COMPUTED: Lean runs each operation of the sequence in order at every grid point (each on the state the one before left, the Lean of each operation as the compiler holds it, `accepted` of each operation its own) and compares the result with the outcome of the sequence's own `run` judged by the sequence's own `accepted`. It is not read off the book's coverage text, the echo, or the words of the sentence.

gates.T7a_sequence_outcome_is_the_last_calls: for every claim whose operation is a sequence (fixtures, controls, the table sentences): at EVERY grid point, the kind of the sequence's outcome equals the kind of the last call's answer when every call answered, and is `no answer` exactly when some call gave none. 100%, at least one point per claim. Expected claims with a sequence line: the 6 fixture claims of features/ledger_rules.feature lines 164, 235, 238, features/ledger.feature line 304, features/wallet_rules.feature lines 10, 13 (if a line has more than one claim, each), and the 2 controls q2_sequence_narrowed_accepted and q2_sequence_narrowed_rejected: at least 8.
gates.T7b_only_sequences: a claim whose operation is one call has no `sequence` line and its printed display is unchanged by this fix; a claim whose operation is a sequence has one, with as many calls as the operation has. 0 exceptions.
gates.T7c_the_reviewers_case: Rule.narrowing_controls.q2_sequence_narrowed_rejected ('A rejected batch followed by a computation of the total is accepted exactly when ...'): the printed display contains the words 'LAST call' and names 'a computation of the total' as that call and 'a batch' as the earlier one; its allowed case (the model's own outcome) is printed with what each call of the sequence did, and that is: the batch accepted (kind 0), the computation of the total rejected (kind 1). The same wording for q2_sequence_narrowed_accepted, whose allowed case is: batch accepted, computation of the total accepted.
gates.T7d_among_the_calls_in_scope_of_the_reje: reported, and gated only as: among the generated calls at which the sequence is rejected there is at least one in which the batch (the earlier call) is accepted. That is the case a reader of the narrowing word would get wrong.
gates.T7e_negative_control: the display script of q2_sequence_narrowed_rejected with the last call's notion of acceptance in the step-by-step run replaced by `true` (so the steps say the last call is always accepted): the run must report that the sequence's outcome is NOT the last call's at some grid point (display.problems). A hand-built display with agree < points must be reported too (unit test, no Lean).

reported_not_gated.sequence_claims: how many claims have a sequence line, by group
reported_not_gated.by_steps: for each sequence claim, the generated calls in scope counted by what each call of the sequence did
